title: JP - Reminisce is that real Hip Hop
htmlContent:
JP's "Reminisce" is that real Hip Hop that makes people fall in love with this ever growing culture. His presence is felt all through this track as he shows the upmost confidence in himself, as well as his skills to connect all his talents from lyrics, flow, and delivery to make a must hear record.
